documents.problemText: 复制给 Agent 的 Threadshare 链接缺少 format=agent，普通 Viewer 页面不适合继续对话。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Agent 链接明确附加 format=agent，并保持普通 Viewer 与 Agent Markdown 两条展示契约分离。

documents.problemText: 一个只改 URL 参数的小修复被走了过重的评审流程，需要判断变更范围。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 按行为风险选择最小验证面；单一参数变更验证链接输出和回归测试即可，不扩大为系统设计评审。

documents.problemText: 完成 Web 修改后，需要提交、推送并部署 Cloudflare，同时保留可验证的发布结果。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 先跑受影响测试，再提交和推送精确 diff，最后部署 Cloudflare 并记录线上验证地址与版本。

documents.problemText: 滚动聊天内容时 Turns 导航没有稳定高亮当前轮次，点击末尾条目还会定位到前一轮。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 统一滚动观察与点击定位的锚点算法，并用稳定 tie-break 处理相邻 Turn 的交界位置。

documents.problemText: 移动端滚动时 Turns 导航没有停靠顶部，需要兼顾本地预览与线上验证。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 在移动断点使用 sticky 顶部停靠，校验滚动容器、遮挡和安全区，并分别验证本地与线上环境。

documents.problemText: Change log 把已经发布的功能标成未发布，而且遗漏了失效、压缩等近期能力。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 以实际发布状态为准重排版本区块，并从提交记录补齐用户可见功能，不用未发布标签覆盖已上线内容。

documents.problemText: Threadshare Viewer 应优先展示用户问题和 Assistant 最终回复，把连续中间过程按需折叠。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 默认保留 User 与最终 Assistant 消息，连续过程消息合并为可展开区；Agent Markdown 输出保持不变。

documents.problemText: 页面顶部的 Agent review 文案和复制内容不够自然，不能直接引导 Agent 阅读上下文并继续对话。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 入口文案改为接入 Agent 继续对话，复制文本用明确指令要求阅读共享上下文后承接当前任务。

documents.problemText: 希望分析哪些 Tool 使用频繁、在哪类问题中使用，以及失败和重复调用的路径。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 从 Session Fact 建 Tool 使用、结果状态、问题类型和顺序路径投影，所有统计可下钻到 Turn 证据。

documents.problemText: Skill 分析不能依赖用户或 Agent 主动记录，需要从会话中无感恢复加载证据。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 结构化 Skill 注入作为强证据，读取已知 SKILL.md 作为弱证据，不建立不存在的 Skill 调用树。

documents.problemText: Codex 与 Claude Session 的记录形状不同，需要在不猜测的前提下恢复 Skill 和 Tool 证据。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 分别冻结 provider 权威记录类；Claude Skill tool_use 与 Codex 结构化注入单独解析，未知记录只记 coverage。

documents.problemText: 本地个人 Insights 完成后，用户需要知道如何使用以及能解决哪些问题。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 提供本地索引、问题检索、Tool 路径和证据下钻，默认不上传 Session，并明确 coverage 与不确定性。

documents.problemText: 本机 Session 数量和体积都很大，Threadshare Insights 可能遇到回填、内存和查询性能瓶颈。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 采用增量 checkpoint、有界流式解析、单事务索引和规模 benchmark，分别约束吞吐、RSS、磁盘与查询延迟。

documents.problemText: 索引和查询算法决定后续分析能否扩展，不能先做 UI 再补数据结构。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 先冻结 Fact Model、倒排字段、候选召回、排序解释和版本轴，再让新增 Projection 在不重读 raw Session 的情况下演进。

documents.problemText: 只安装 Threadshare 时，希望内置 Rust 索引引擎，同时确认原生实现是否真的带来收益。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 以 Node 版本下限和基准为决策条件；Rust sidecar 固定 SQLite/FTS 能力并通过多平台预编译包分发。

documents.problemText: 需要判断外部 CodeGraph 项目对 Threadshare 索引架构是否有可复用价值。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 借鉴其预编译原生组件和能力分层，但数据库层仍按 Threadshare 的事务一致性与查询需求独立选择。

documents.problemText: bootstrap 的作用和边界不清楚，容易和普通安装、稳定发布或自动部署混为一谈。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: bootstrap 只为首次创建平台包名和 Trusted Publisher 配置，必须单独授权，不能发布 latest 或重复执行。

documents.problemText: 需要用大白话解释索引、存储和查询逻辑，并确认初始 Fact 数据结构能支持未来分析。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Raw Session 是最终权威，Fact 保存稳定可扩展事实，Projection 负责可重建索引与分析；新增判断不污染 Fact。

documents.problemText: Fact Model 补齐后，需要正式批准 Epic，并用 cs-epic 持续推进到最终验收。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 冻结授权状态和子项契约，逐 ITEM 实现、验证、独立审查与里程碑提交，最后统一 push。

documents.problemText: 长时间实现过程中需要同步进展、断线续跑，并把大规模测试数据整理成可审计证据。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 持续维护 work cursor 和阶段状态；恢复时从当前 ITEM 继续，最终提交去敏 fixture、聚合报告和可复现命令。

documents.problemText: An Agent handoff opens the regular Viewer because the copied review link does not request the Agent transcript format.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Append format=agent only to the Agent handoff URL and keep Viewer HTML separate from the Markdown transcript contract.

documents.problemText: A narrowly scoped URL parameter correction was routed through a system-sized review and verification process.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Match review depth to behavioral risk: verify the generated link and its regression test without reopening unrelated architecture.

documents.problemText: The Web update is complete locally and now needs an auditable commit, remote push, and Cloudflare deployment.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Run affected checks, commit the exact change, push the candidate, deploy Cloudflare, and retain the deployed revision for verification.

documents.problemText: Turns navigation selects the preceding entry near message boundaries, and scrolling does not consistently track the visible turn.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Use one anchor-selection rule for click and scroll observers, with a stable boundary tie break for adjacent turns.

documents.problemText: On a narrow viewport the Turns control scrolls away instead of remaining available at the top of the conversation.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Apply sticky positioning inside the actual mobile scroll container and verify offsets, safe areas, and content occlusion.

documents.problemText: Release notes still call shipped work unreleased and omit recently delivered expiration and compression behavior.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Reconcile the change log with published versions and recover user-visible features from milestone commits before editing release sections.

documents.problemText: The Viewer gives every intermediate assistant message equal weight, hiding the user questions and final responses.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Keep user turns and final assistant answers expanded, and group consecutive process messages into an optional disclosure.

documents.problemText: The review-link label and copied text do not tell an Agent to consume shared context before continuing the task.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Name the action as continuing with an Agent and copy a direct instruction to read the transcript and resume the conversation.

documents.problemText: Local analysis should show which tools recur, their result states, and the kinds of later problems associated with each path.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Project tool uses, outcomes, turn topics, and ordered paths from facts while preserving evidence links for every aggregate.

documents.problemText: Skill analytics currently assumes explicit user recording even though load evidence already exists in provider sessions.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Use structured Skill injection as strong evidence and an exact catalog-backed SKILL.md read as weak evidence without inventing a call graph.

documents.problemText: Codex and Claude encode tool and Skill activity in different record classes, making a shared heuristic unsafe.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Freeze provider-specific authoritative shapes, reject guessed record roles, and report unknown classes as coverage diagnostics.

documents.problemText: The local Insights proposal needs a concrete user workflow rather than an abstract list of possible analytics.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Offer private local indexing, historical problem search, tool-path summaries, and turn evidence drill-down with visible uncertainty.

documents.problemText: Thousands of large session files may overwhelm initial backfill, memory, storage, or interactive query latency.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Use bounded streaming and incremental checkpoints, then enforce separate throughput, RSS, disk, freshness, and query benchmarks.

documents.problemText: The product design started before defining durable facts, inverted fields, candidate retrieval, and ranking version boundaries.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Freeze the fact model and query pipeline first so future projections can evolve without rereading raw provider sessions.

documents.problemText: A global Threadshare installation should include the local index engine without requiring a Rust toolchain on the user machine.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Ship a pinned Rust sidecar through verified platform packages, and justify native complexity with Node-version and benchmark constraints.

documents.problemText: An external CodeGraph implementation may offer useful packaging patterns but solves a different database problem.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Reuse its native distribution lessons while evaluating storage and transaction choices against Threadshare-specific facts and queries.

documents.problemText: The term bootstrap is being confused with normal installation and the stable package release workflow.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Limit bootstrap to one-time package-name creation and trusted-publisher setup under separate authorization, never latest publication.

documents.problemText: The first schema must support later analytics while keeping raw sessions authoritative and avoiding repeated full parsing.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Store stable provider facts separately from rebuildable search and analysis projections; version judgments instead of embedding them in facts.

documents.problemText: After the Fact Model contract is complete, the approved Epic needs a controlled path through implementation and final acceptance.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Freeze authorization, execute each item with tests and independent review, create milestone commits, and push only at the final boundary.

documents.problemText: A long-running implementation was interrupted and its large benchmark corpus must remain understandable and reproducible.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Resume from the work cursor, report concrete item progress, and archive deidentified fixtures, aggregate results, and exact commands.

documents.problemText: Copy review link 打开 Viewer HTML，因为 URL 没有请求 format=agent transcript。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 只在 Agent handoff URL 加 format=agent，普通 Viewer 和 Markdown contract 继续分离。

documents.problemText: 一个 URL parameter 小改动被扩大成 system-level review，scope 与 risk 不匹配。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 验证 generated link 和 regression test 即可，不把 unrelated architecture 拉进 review。

documents.problemText: Web change 本地完成后，需要 commit、remote push 和 Cloudflare deployment 的可审计链路。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: affected tests 通过后提交 exact diff，push candidate，再 deploy 并记录 deployed revision。

documents.problemText: Turns observer 在 message boundary 选到 previous item，click 和 scroll 的 anchor 规则不一致。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: click/scroll 共用 anchor selection，并给 adjacent Turn boundary 一个 stable tie-break。

documents.problemText: mobile viewport 下 Turns control 会随 content 滚走，没有保持 top access。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 在真实 scroll container 内使用 sticky positioning，并检查 safe-area、offset 和 overlap。

documents.problemText: change log 把 shipped work 标成 unreleased，expire/compression milestone 也没有同步。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 按 published version 重排 sections，并从 milestone commits 恢复 user-visible features。

documents.problemText: Viewer 把 every Assistant process message 都展开，User question 和 final answer 反而不突出。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: User/final Assistant 默认 expanded，consecutive process messages 合并为 optional disclosure。

documents.problemText: Agent review label 与 copied prompt 没有说明先 read shared context 再 continue。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: action 命名为 continue with Agent，prompt 明确 consume transcript and resume task。

documents.problemText: local analytics 需要回答 Tool frequency、result state 和后续 problem path。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 从 Facts projection Tool use/outcome/topic/order，并让 aggregate 可 drill down 到 Turn evidence。

documents.problemText: Skill analytics 依赖 explicit recording，但 provider session 已有 injection 和 SKILL.md read evidence。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: structured injection 算 strong，catalog-backed exact read 算 weak，不构造 Skill call tree。

documents.problemText: Codex/Claude 的 Tool 与 Skill record class 不同，shared heuristic 会产生 false evidence。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 冻结 provider-specific authority，unknown class 只增加 coverage diagnostic，不猜 role。

documents.problemText: local personal Insights 只有 abstract feature list，没有 concrete user workflow。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 提供 local index、history search、Tool path 和 evidence drill-down，并展示 uncertainty。

documents.problemText: thousands of session files 可能压垮 backfill throughput、RSS、disk 与 query latency。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: bounded streaming 加 incremental checkpoint，并分别设置 throughput/RSS/disk/freshness gates。

documents.problemText: UI 之前没有冻结 Fact Model、inverted fields、candidate retrieval 和 ranker version。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 先定 fact/query pipeline，让 future Projection 不读 raw provider session 也能 evolve。

documents.problemText: global Threadshare install 希望拿到 local Rust index engine，不要求 local compile。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 用 verified platform packages 分发 pinned sidecar，并以 Node floor 和 benchmark 证明 native cost。

documents.problemText: external CodeGraph 有 native packaging pattern，但 database consistency problem 不同。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 复用 distribution lesson，storage/transaction 仍按 Threadshare Fact 与 query contract 决策。

documents.problemText: bootstrap 被误当作 normal install 或 stable release 的一部分。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: bootstrap 只做 one-time package name 与 Trusted Publisher setup，需要 separate authorization。

documents.problemText: initial schema 要支持 future analytics，同时 raw session 仍是 source of truth。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: stable provider Facts 与 rebuildable Projection 分层，version judgment，不重复 full parse。

documents.problemText: Fact Model contract 完成后，approved Epic 需要持续执行到 final acceptance。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: freeze authorization，逐 ITEM test/review/milestone，最终 boundary 才统一 push。

documents.problemText: long-running implementation 断线后要 resume，large benchmark corpus 也要可复现。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 从 work cursor continue，报告 item progress，并 archive deidentified fixture、aggregate 和 commands。

documents.problemText: A local search index reports an analyzer version mismatch after an upgrade. How should it be rebuilt without mixing old and new tokens?
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Build a shadow projection with the new analyzer identity, verify it, then atomically activate it while retaining the facts as the source of truth.

documents.problemText: Warm full-text searches became slow because document-frequency lookup scans the whole vocabulary before candidate retrieval.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Use bounded parameterized term seeks, verify the virtual-table seek plan, and measure candidate retrieval separately from reranking.

documents.problemText: A command failed with a nonzero exit code and the agent issued the same normalized input again. Is this a retry or an unrelated repeat?
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Treat the second call as retry-after-failure only when the prior result is failed and the salted input fingerprint matches.

documents.problemText: The transcript contains a Skill catalog and a later file read. Which evidence is strong enough to count a Skill load?
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Count structured provider injection as confirmed evidence; treat a matching catalog-backed Skill file read as inferred evidence and keep the strengths separate.

documents.problemText: A provider rollback hides a previous turn, but its text is still present in search results and evidence pointers.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Apply rollback visibility in the same transaction, delete the turn projection, and retain only content-free rollback evidence.

documents.problemText: A tool filter is applied after the top candidate limit, so relevant filtered turns disappear before ranking.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Intersect structured filters with the full-text match before the candidate limit and preserve a deterministic row-key tie break.

documents.problemText: Chinese text mixed with identifiers is poorly recalled because the analyzer only splits on whitespace.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Normalize Unicode, emit bounded CJK bigrams and trigrams, and preserve identifier shapes such as camelCase and snake_case.

documents.problemText: The process is killed between committing facts and acknowledging the request. How can replay avoid duplicate projections?
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Commit facts, projections, checkpoint, and idempotency key in one transaction; replay the same delta key to return the existing commit.

documents.problemText: A large turn has more evidence events than one response frame can safely return.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Return the bounded turn summary on every page and paginate only events and capability uses with a revision-aware cursor.

documents.problemText: A JavaScript CLI needs a native search engine on six platforms while keeping installation deterministic.
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: Publish exact-version platform packages first, verify their signed artifacts, and publish the root package last with optional platform dependencies.

documents.problemText: 升级后 turn-search@1 和 turn-search@2 同时出现，analyzerVersion 不一致，应该怎样 rebuild？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 创建 shadow projection，写入 mixed-cjk-code@1 identity，校验完成后用 atomic activate 切换版本。

documents.problemText: SEARCH_TURNS 的 P95 变慢，fts5vocab 查询出现 full scan，candidate LIMIT 300 之前耗时很高。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 使用 term IN (?, ...) 的 bounded seek，并把 df lookup、posting filter 和 rerank timing 分开记录。

documents.problemText: runTask() 返回 exitCode=1，随后相同 inputFingerprint 再调用一次，relation 应该是什么？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 前一次 providerTerminalState=failed 且 fingerprint 相同，则标记 retry-after-failure，而不是 same-input-repeat。

documents.problemText: 日志先出现 skills catalog，之后 Read(SKILL.md)，如何区分 confirmed 与 inferred skill-load？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 结构化注入记 confirmed；catalog 已存在且路径精确匹配的读取记 inferred，二者不能合并计数。

documents.problemText: thread_rolled_back(num_turns=1) 后旧 Turn 仍能被 MATCH 找到，evidence pointer 也还指向旧内容。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 同一 transaction 更新 providerVisibility 并删除 FTS row；报告只保留 content-free rollback marker。

documents.problemText: toolCapabilityKeys filter 放在 LIMIT 300 之后，为什么 SearchResult 会漏掉真正匹配的 Turn？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 先在 SQL candidate query 中 intersect filter，再 LIMIT 和 rerank，并用 rowid ASC 保证 tie-break。

documents.problemText: 查询“索引 rebuildFoo_bar”时只命中英文 token，CJK bigram 和 camelCase shape 没有进入 analyzer。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 先做 NFKC/lowercase，再产生 CJK 2-gram/3-gram 与 rebuild、foo、bar、camel、snake code tokens。

documents.problemText: COMMIT_SESSION 已 durable，但 ACK 前 sidecar crash；同一个 deltaId replay 会不会重复写 projection？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 把 deltaId、facts、projection 和 checkpoint 放进一个 immediate transaction，重复请求直接返回既有 snapshot。

documents.problemText: READ_TURN_EVIDENCE 超过 4 MiB frame，cursor 翻页后 Turn summary 是否需要重复返回？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 每页固定返回 SafeTurnFact，cursor 只推进 Event/CapabilityUse，并绑定 expectedRevision 防止跨版本混读。

documents.problemText: npm root package 要加载 Rust sidecar，darwin-arm64 和 linux-x64 等 platform package 怎样发布？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 平台包用 exact version 与 os/cpu metadata 先发布，registry smoke 通过后 root-last publish。

documents.problemText: 升级分析器后，本地索引提示版本不一致，怎样避免新旧分词结果混在一起？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 从事实层重建一份影子投影，记录新的分析器身份，校验后再原子切换。

documents.problemText: 全文搜索变慢，查询文档频率时扫描了整个词表，候选召回之前就耗时很久。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 使用有界参数化词项查找并验证走索引，同时把召回和重排耗时分别统计。

documents.problemText: 工具调用以非零状态结束，随后又用相同输入调用了一次，这算重试还是普通重复？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 只有前一次明确失败且输入指纹一致时，才标记为失败后重试。

documents.problemText: 会话里先出现技能目录，后来读取技能说明文件，什么证据足以认定加载了技能？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 结构化注入属于确认加载；目录存在且路径精确匹配的读取只属于推断加载。

documents.problemText: 提供方撤回了上一轮，但被撤回的问题仍然出现在搜索结果和证据指针中。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 在同一事务中更新可见性并删除搜索投影，只保留不含内容的撤回证据。

documents.problemText: 工具筛选在候选数量截断之后才执行，导致真正符合筛选条件的结果提前丢失。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 结构化筛选必须在候选截断前与全文条件相交，并使用稳定键解决同分排序。

documents.problemText: 中文和代码标识符混合的查询召回很差，因为分析器只按空格切词。
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 统一字符规范后生成有界中文二元和三元词项，同时拆分驼峰与下划线标识符。

documents.problemText: 事实已经提交但确认返回前进程退出，重放请求怎样避免重复写入投影？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 事实、投影、检查点和幂等键必须在一个事务内提交，相同变更重放时返回已有结果。

documents.problemText: 单轮证据太多，超过一次响应允许的大小，应该怎样安全分页？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 每页都返回有界轮次摘要，只对事件和工具使用翻页，并让游标绑定事实修订版本。

documents.problemText: 命令行工具要在六个平台安装原生搜索引擎，怎样保证分发顺序和产物一致？
documents.finalAnswerExcerpt: 先发布并验证固定版本的平台包，完成签名与安装冒烟后，最后发布根包。
